summary: Full-Stack Engineer with 3 years of experience, currently working as AI & System Optimization Engineer / Solutions Architect at MarketEnterprise Vietnam. Strong in NestJS, Next.js, ReactJS, and microservices architecture on AWS. Expanding into AI/ML (RAG, LLM deployment) and DevSecOps. Focused on high-performance, secure, and maintainable systems.

solves.problem: Large-scale systems difficult to scale and maintain
solves.approach: Decompose into microservices within NX Monorepo, clear API boundaries, automated CI/CD pipelines per environment (dev/staging/prod).

solves.problem: Synchronizing and processing multi-source realtime data
solves.approach: Event-driven serverless architecture — queues and schedules decouple services for easy scaling with load.

solves.problem: Integrating LLMs into products while maintaining accuracy and safety
solves.approach: RAG anchors answers to real documents, embeddings + internal LLM deployment to control data and reduce hallucination.

solves.problem: Slow systems and high operational costs
solves.approach: Optimize queries/indexes, separate workloads, design cost-efficient cloud infrastructure.
